fusions.name: Whipcrack Reach
fusions.desc: Whips an arm into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. You have 4 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Inkblot Roar
fusions.desc: Spews a cloud ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Many Arms Flurry
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Eighth Hold
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a stack, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 5% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
